products.description: With a stay at this apartment in Cape Town (Cape Town City Centre), you'll be a 3-minute walk from Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village and 11 minutes by foot from Long Street. Featured amenities include laundry facilities and an elevator. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.
